feeds.title: Ely Tri Club Blog
feeds.description: Get all the race reports, experiences, results, club news, and much more in the blog space. At Ely Tri Club, we're all about fun and competitive sports. Our experienced coaches train our team to reach their highest potential and to always have a great time whenever we play. Our committee is active and always strives for members to fulfill their potential!

feeds.title: Dark Lord Speaks
feeds.description: Hello, This is Mark, and welcome to my blog where I write about all my experiences and views on duathlon. Read all the blogs to stay in touch and witness how I venture forward to glory! I am a coach, duathlete, cyclist, and runner who loves to race and share something about the same!

feeds.title: Carlo Carrasco » Duathlon
feeds.description: Greetings! I am Carlo Carrasco and welcome to my blog. Read all the blog posts to get the information on all the race events and much more taking place in the Philippines. I am an author, preacher, copywriter, publisher, and also a blogger. I also do freelance projects to help small businesses and private organizations achieve their goals in publicity and marketing which contributed to their growth over the years.

feeds.title: Can But Tri Blog
feeds.description: Hi! We are Jill & Iain and welcome to our blog where you will find event announcements, race reports, and other useful information. We have an extensive background within sports from grassroots to elite level competition, coaching, and event management. We are qualified health professionals who have worked for the NHS and other organizations for many years and are therefore keen to promote an active and healthy lifestyle for everyone regardless of ability.

feeds.title: Team AFR Blog
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to our blog space. Read all the race experiences, views, and much more on endurance races.We are brothers and multi-sport athletes who began competing in 2013. Our motto is 'We tri it; we du it.'

feeds.title: SwimBikeRun Fun Blog » Duathlon Training
feeds.description: Hi! This is Camille, and welcome to my blog space. We intend to share one of the best information on beginner gear, training tips & advice. We are a 100% women's run organization whose main goal is to expose, educate and empower all WOMEN in athletic multi-sports disciplines through clinics, events, and races.
